input.objective:
Launch Pondside (POND) with a Uniswap v4 hook on Ethereum, paired with IMD.
Token: Pondside (POND), the standard launch token: 1,000,000,000 supply, 18 decimals, plain transfers, no owner functions.
The hook does exactly what the creator describes below, and nothing else.
In the creator’s own words: <description>Observe swaps without charging any hook fee or granting owner powers.</description>
No owner functions, no backend signer, no upgrade path.
Fees are always taken from the IMD (pair currency) side, never from POND; a fee the PoolManager cannot pay directly is minted as a claim the recipient can redeem.
Enable beforeInitialize (required by the IMD launch factory) and only the callbacks the behavior above needs. Take the PoolManager as a constructor argument. Owner, if any, is $owner.
Pool: 50% of my 90% share seeds the pool; the remainder goes to the paying wallet.
Keep the function names exactly as written so the storefront can show them. Composed with The Hooks Store.
